grownups.essentials: Currency: 1 SGD ≈ A$1.09 — bring S$150–200 cash for hawkers. Singapore plug: UK Type G 3-pin 230V — bring adapters. eSIM or Singtel tourist SIM. Grab app for rideshare. SimplyGo card for MRT (buy at Changi on arrival). Emergency: Police 999 / Ambulance 995.
checklist: All 5 passports — valid 6 months beyond 7 July
EpiPen (×2) for Lenny — in adult bag, accessible at ALL times
Flight confirmations: QF883/QF71 out, QF82/QF733 home
Hotel confirmations: Village Hotel Sentosa / Mandai Ref 47596SG020518 / Treetops Bukit Timah
Download Grab + offline Google Maps before leaving
Travel credit card (no foreign transaction fees)
Notify bank of travel 26 Jun – 8 Jul
grownups.transport: Grab for door-to-door. MRT (SimplyGo): fast and cheap across the city. Sentosa Express + island buses free on island. Day 11: cable car scenic entry into Sentosa — one way in, MRT home.

days.label: Day 1
days.did_you_know: We fly Adelaide → Perth at 6:05am, then Perth → Singapore, arriving at 5:50pm. A long day in the air but so worth it — Singapore is waiting! 🌏

weather.summary: Tropical and humid — 32°C, way warmer than Adelaide!

star_challenge.title: Flight Challenge
star_challenge.prompt: Name the 3 countries you fly over on the way from Perth to Singapore!

activities.title: Adelaide → Perth → Singapore
activities.body: We leave Adelaide really early — 6:05am! We stop in Perth first, then onto the big flight to Singapore. Singapore is in Southeast Asia, near the equator — that's why it's so warm! Tiny country, enormous adventures.
facts: Singapore is so small you can drive across the whole island in about 30 minutes. But it has over 5 million people living there! 🌏

challenge.prompt: How many time zones away is Singapore from Adelaide?
challenge.answer: 1.5 hours ahead! Singapore stays in the same time zone all year — when it's 12pm in Adelaide it's 1:30pm in Singapore!

explorer_plus.fact: Singapore sits about 137 km north of the Equator, so day and night are almost exactly 12 hours long all year round — no long summer evenings like back home!

quiz.q: Singapore has very little natural fresh water. How does it supply enough for 5+ million people?
quiz.a: It recycles used water into ultra-clean 'NEWater', collects rain across 17 reservoirs, desalinates seawater, and imports some from Malaysia.

avoid_dishes: Any seasonal specials with nut-containing sauces — check menu
meal.allergy_protocol: Shake Shack burgers and plain fries are nut-free. Confirm with staff that no nut sauces apply to Lenny's order on arrival. Milkshakes are generally safe — avoid any with nut toppings.

safety.note: Lenny: confirm no nut-containing sauces on arrival.

activities.title: First dinner in Singapore!
activities.body: First dinner in Singapore and it's Shake Shack — right on Siloso Beach! After a very long day of flying, burgers and shakes steps from a tropical island beach. Perfect. 🌴
facts: Shake Shack started as a hot dog cart in New York City in 2001. Now it's in over 40 countries — this one on a tropical island beach might be the best one. 🌏

challenge.prompt: While you eat, count how many different languages you can hear around you. Singapore has 4 official languages — how many can you spot?
challenge.answer: Singapore's 4 official languages are English, Mandarin, Malay, and Tamil. You'll likely hear all of them!

days.label: Day 2
days.did_you_know: Sentosa Island was once called Pulau Blakang Mati — Malay for 'Island Behind Death'. They renamed it Sentosa ('Peace and Tranquillity') in 1972. Quite the upgrade! 🏝️

weather.summary: Hot and sunny — 32°C. Lather on the SPF early!

star_challenge.title: Sentosa Explorer
star_challenge.prompt: How many different types of transport can you use ON Sentosa Island today?

activities.title: Beach swim and sand time
activities.body: Sentosa has three amazing beaches — Palawan, Siloso, and Tanjong. Crystal clear water and white sand. Perfect for swimming, building sandcastles, and digging holes.
facts: The sea around Singapore is part of the South China Sea! It stays about 29°C all year — like a giant warm bathtub. 🌊

challenge.prompt: Take a family jump shot — everyone in the air at the same time! Mum or Dad counts 3-2-1 JUMP! 🦘 Who gets the best air?
challenge.answer: Show everyone back home your best jump shot! 📸

activities.title: The giant nest playground
activities.body: Nestopia is an incredible open-air adventure playground right by the sea! 17 different sections with climbing nets, rope bridges, mazes and obstacle courses — plus two of the LONGEST slides on all of Sentosa (7.5 metres up!).
facts: The playground is built like giant bird nests — can you spot all 3 huge nests as you climb through? 🕸️

challenge.prompt: Race to the TOP of Nestopia and back without stopping — time yourself! Can you beat your siblings? First one back to the bottom WINS! 🏁
challenge.answer: Don't forget to tag the giant nests at the top before you come back down!

activities.title: Race down the Luge tracks!
activities.body: The Skyline Luge is SO MUCH FUN! First, a chairlift up to the top of the hill — then hop in your luge cart and race down special winding tracks. Push forward to speed up, pull back to brake. Multiple runs, each track different!
facts: The luge tracks at Sentosa wind through trees with cool twists and turns. Under 6s ride with a grown-up — Lenny gets a personal racing partner! 🏎️

challenge.prompt: Challenge Mum or Dad to a luge race! Winner picks where we eat dinner. Track your wins — who gets the most? 🏆
challenge.answer: Top tip: lean into the turns and push forward on the straights for maximum speed!

explorer_plus.fact: The Skyline Luge was invented in New Zealand — it started in Rotorua in the 1980s before coming to Sentosa.

quiz.q: The Skyline Luge ride was invented in which country?
quiz.a: New Zealand — it started in Rotorua in the 1980s before coming to Sentosa.

weather.summary: Warm and partly cloudy — great for outdoor exploring!

star_challenge.title: Ocean Spotter
star_challenge.prompt: Find ALL 5 before you leave the Oceanarium: 🦈 Shark  🐙 Octopus  🦑 Jellyfish  🐡 Pufferfish  🐢 Sea Turtle!

activities.title: One of the biggest aquariums in the world!
activities.body: The Singapore Oceanarium has over 100,000 sea creatures from 1,000 different species! Walk through a real underwater tunnel while sharks and rays glide overhead.
facts: The aquarium holds about 45 million litres of water — enough to fill 18 Olympic swimming pools! 🏊

challenge.prompt: Find ALL 5 before you leave: 🦈 Shark  🐙 Octopus  🦑 Jellyfish  🐡 Pufferfish  🐢 Sea Turtle. Shout when you spot one!
challenge.answer: The jellyfish glow room is near the end — don't miss it! And look UP in the tunnel for sharks swimming right over you!

explorer_plus.fact: The underwater tunnel lets you stand still while sharks glide overhead — the moving feeling is just the fish, not you!

quiz.q: Britain's Prime Minister called the 1942 fall of Singapore the worst what in British military history?
quiz.a: Winston Churchill called it the 'worst disaster' (and largest surrender) in British military history.

activities.title: A real WWII fort — and it's free!
activities.body: Fort Siloso is a real military fort built in the 1880s to protect Singapore! It has tunnels, huge guns, and bunkers you can explore. And it's completely free to visit.
facts: The fort's giant guns could fire shells weighing nearly a TONNE — heavier than a car! 💥

challenge.prompt: What year did Japan capture Singapore during World War 2? Guess before you look at the signs inside!
challenge.answer: 1942! Japan captured Singapore on 15 February 1942. It was called 'the Fall of Singapore'.

meal.allergy_protocol: Wood-fired casual beach menu. Inform staff of Lenny's nut anaphylaxis on arrival — ask them to flag it to the kitchen. Confirm each of Lenny's dishes contains no nut-based sauces or dressings.

safety.note: Lenny: inform staff of nut anaphylaxis on arrival.

activities.title: Sunset dinner on the sand
activities.body: Tanjong Beach Club is one of Singapore's most famous beach clubs! Dinner right on the sand watching the sun set over the ocean. Reservation confirmed: Coastal Table, 6pm.

challenge.prompt: Capture the perfect sunset silhouette — everyone facing away from the setting sun. Who takes the most magical shot? 🌅
challenge.answer: Face AWAY from the sunset so your faces are in shadow — that's how you get a perfect silhouette photo!

days.label: Day 4
days.did_you_know: We picked Monday for Adventure Cove because it's the least busy day — shorter queues = MORE RIDES! 🎉

weather.summary: 32°C and sunny — perfect waterpark weather! Reapply SPF every 2 hours.

star_challenge.title: Rainbow Spotter
star_challenge.prompt: In the snorkel lagoon, find a fish for every colour of the rainbow: 🔴🟠🟡🟢🔵🟣 — tick them off!

location.name: Adventure Cove Waterpark, Resorts World Sentosa

activities.title: Waterpark + snorkel with tropical fish!
activities.body: Adventure Cove is an EPIC waterpark with a twist — you can snorkel alongside real tropical fish and sharks at Rainbow Reef! Plus Asia's first hydromagnetic coaster, a wave pool, duelling slides, and a lazy river.
facts: Riptide Rocket uses magnets to push the raft UPHILL — a waterslide that goes UP! 🚀

challenge.prompt: In the snorkel lagoon, find a fish for every colour of the rainbow: 🔴🟠🟡🟢🔵🟣 Tick them off as you go!
challenge.answer: Clownfish (like Nemo!) are bright orange. Surgeonfish are vivid blue. Check near the coral for purple ones!

explorer_plus.fact: A hydromagnetic coaster uses magnets to push the raft uphill — a water slide can suddenly go UP, not just down.

quiz.q: Why does the sea at Adventure Cove feel warmer than an Adelaide beach?
quiz.a: Singapore is tropical and near the Equator, so the sea stays about 28–30°C all year round.

weather.summary: Warm and overcast — great for the animals at Night Safari!

hotel.name: Mandai Rainforest Resort
hotel.note: We sleep in the ACTUAL rainforest tonight! 🦜

star_challenge.title: Night Vision Challenge
star_challenge.prompt: Spot 5 nocturnal animals without using your phone torch — let your eyes adjust to the dark!

activities.title: Asia's first river-themed wildlife park
activities.body: River Wonders explores 8 different river habitats from around the world — Amazon to the Yangtze! You can also see GIANT PANDAS here — rare black and white bears from China.
facts: Giant pandas eat mostly bamboo — and they eat for up to 14 hours a day! They need so much because bamboo isn't very nutritious. 🐼

challenge.prompt: Giant Pandas eat mostly one thing. What is it, and how many hours a day do they eat it?
challenge.answer: BAMBOO! Up to 14 hours a day — they need so much because bamboo isn't very nutritious.

explorer_plus.fact: The Night Safari opened in 1994 and was the world's first zoo built just for night-time animals.

quiz.q: Giant pandas are loaned between countries as a kind of friendship gift. What is this nicknamed?
quiz.a: 'Panda diplomacy' — China lends pandas to build friendships with other countries.

activities.title: The world's first nocturnal zoo
activities.body: THIS IS THE WORLD'S FIRST NOCTURNAL ZOO — it only opens at NIGHT so you see animals that only come out in the dark. Walk-through trails and a tram ride through live animal habitats.
facts: Nocturnal animals have special eyes that work brilliantly in the dark. A leopard can see 7 times better than a human at night! 👁️

challenge.prompt: Without using your phone light, try to spot 5 animals using ONLY your night vision eyes. The longer you stay in the dark, the better your eyes get — trust them!
challenge.answer: It takes about 20 minutes for your eyes to fully adjust to the dark. The animals can see YOU much better than you can see them!

days.label: Day 6
days.did_you_know: Today might be the most magical morning of the WHOLE TRIP. Get ready! 🦧

weather.summary: Warm and humid in the rainforest — 30°C. Insect repellent essential!

hotel.name: Treetops Singapore, Bukit Timah
hotel.note: Self-catering — stock up at Cold Storage / FairPrice on arrival. 6 nights here!

star_challenge.title: Rainforest Explorer
star_challenge.prompt: Find these 4 things in the rainforest today: 🦎 Lizard  🦋 Butterfly  🌸 Flower on a tree  🍄 Mushroom or fungus!

activities.title: Eating breakfast while orangutans swing nearby
activities.body: We eat breakfast while orangutans swing around in the open-air habitat right next to us — no glass, no fences, just fruit and coffee and wild apes! This is a genuine once-in-a-lifetime moment.
facts: The word 'orangutan' comes from Malay: 'orang' (person) + 'utan' (forest) = PERSON OF THE FOREST! 🌿

challenge.prompt: Get a photo that looks like an orangutan is sitting RIGHT behind you — like it's photobombing your breakfast! 🦧📸
challenge.answer: This will be the most amazing photo of the whole trip. Frame it when you get home!

explorer_plus.fact: Orangutans share around 97% of their DNA with humans — they're one of our closest animal relatives.

quiz.q: Orangutans live wild on only two islands on Earth. Can you name them?
quiz.a: Borneo and Sumatra, in South-East Asia.

location.name: Rainforest Wild ASIA, Mandai Wildlife Reserve

activities.title: Asia's first adventure-based wildlife park
activities.body: Brand new park — we're some of the first people to explore it! Climb a giant karst rock (Wild Apex), crawl through a real cave (Wild Cavern), jump 20 metres (Wild Drop), and walk high above the forest floor (Treetop Walk).
facts: Wild Drop is 20 metres high — about as tall as a 6-storey building. You jump off it! 🪂

challenge.prompt: Find these 4 in the rainforest: 🦎 A lizard on a rock  🦋 A butterfly  🌸 A flower growing on a tree  🍄 A mushroom or fungus!
challenge.answer: Look LOW for lizards (they like warm rocks), HIGH for butterflies, and check tree trunks for flowers and fungi!

days.label: Day 7
days.did_you_know: After two big wildlife days at Mandai, today is a gentler explore day in our new Bukit Timah neighbourhood — the Botanic Gardens are practically next door!

weather.summary: Warm and partly sunny — 31°C. Good walking weather!

star_challenge.title: Orchid Hunter
star_challenge.prompt: Find and photograph Singapore's national flower — the Vanda Miss Joaquim orchid! It's purple and white. First one finds it wins a treat! 🌺

location.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens (UNESCO World Heritage Site)

activities.title: A UNESCO garden that's been here 160 years
activities.body: The Singapore Botanic Gardens is a UNESCO World Heritage Site — one of the most important and special places on Earth! The National Orchid Garden has over 1,000 types of orchid.
facts: Singapore's national flower is the Vanda Miss Joaquim orchid — a beautiful purple and white flower first registered in Singapore in 1893! 🌸

challenge.prompt: Find and photograph Singapore's national flower — the Vanda Miss Joaquim orchid! It's purple and white. First one finds it wins a treat! 🌺
challenge.answer: Head to the National Orchid Garden — over 1,000 types of orchid including the Vanda Miss Joaquim. Look for the purple-and-white one!

explorer_plus.fact: Experiments with rubber trees at these Gardens in the 1890s helped launch all of South-East Asia's rubber industry.

quiz.q: Why was the Vanda Miss Joaquim orchid chosen as Singapore's national flower?
quiz.a: It's tough, blooms year-round, and was the first orchid hybrid registered in Singapore, back in 1893.

location.name: Museum of Ice Cream, Dempsey Hill

activities.title: Interactive ice cream wonderland
activities.body: Not a boring museum! An interactive wonderland of ice cream and candy themes. The floors, walls and everything respond and play. There's even a POOL — but instead of water it's filled with millions of rainbow sprinkles! 🌈
facts: The sprinkle pool has actual millions of sprinkles in it. You can swim (carefully!) through them!

challenge.prompt: Try the MOST UNUSUAL flavour you find — the weirdest one available. No chickening out! Rate it 1–10 and describe the taste to everyone. 😜
challenge.answer: Being brave with food is a superpower — even if it's gross, you'll have a great story!

hawker_recs: Laksa — spicy coconut noodle soup, Singapore's favourite
Oyster omelette (chai tow kway) — crispy egg with oysters
BBQ stingray — sounds scary, tastes amazing!
Chicken rice — safe for Lenny (no peanut sauce)
Satay — Savy/Tay only (peanut sauce unsafe for Lenny)
meal.allergy_protocol: CRITICAL: many hawker sauces contain peanuts. Before ordering for Lenny, ask each stall: 'Does this contain peanut or nut sauce?' Safe options: plain chicken rice (request no peanut sauce), char kway teow, plain grilled items. EpiPen in bag. When in doubt, order plain rice with grilled chicken from a confirmed-safe stall.

safety.note: Lenny: HIGH peanut sauce risk at hawker centres. Ask every stall before ordering.

activities.title: Singapore hawker food!
activities.body: A hawker centre is Singapore's version of a food court — outdoors, with lots of different stalls each cooking one special dish. They're AMAZING and super popular with locals.
facts: Newton Food Centre is one of Singapore's most famous hawker centres — it's been here since 1971! Locals and tourists both love it equally. 🍜

challenge.prompt: Savy and Tay must try ONE thing they've never eaten before — be brave! Rate your mystery food 1–10 after tasting. Mum or Dad checks everything for Lenny first. 🌶️
challenge.answer: Singapore hawker food is some of the best in the world. Even the weird-looking stuff is usually delicious!

safety.note: Lenny: confirm no peanut sauce before ordering. High vigilance at hawker stalls.

days.label: Day 8
days.did_you_know: Every Friday at teamLab, kids under 12 get in FREE with an adult ticket — that means Tay and Lenny don't pay! 🙌

weather.summary: Warm and humid — 31°C. Perfect for indoor air-con art!

star_challenge.title: Little India Explorer
star_challenge.prompt: Spot all 4 in Little India: 🌼 Marigold garland  🛕 Hindu temple  🌶️ Spice being ground  📜 Tamil script sign!

location.name: teamLab Future World, ArtScience Museum, Marina Bay

activities.title: Digital art that reacts when you touch it
activities.body: teamLab is a mind-blowing art experience where EVERYTHING is interactive — floors, walls, ceilings come alive with glowing art that responds when you touch it. In the Sketch Aquarium, you colour a sea creature on paper, staff scans it, and YOUR drawing comes to life swimming on screen!
facts: In the Crystal Universe room, you can literally walk through millions of glowing lights. Touch the screen to change the entire universe around you! ✨

challenge.prompt: In the Crystal Universe room, hold perfectly still for 3 seconds while someone takes your photo — the lights will blur into magic trails around you! ✨
challenge.answer: Put your phone on portrait mode and hold VERY still. The twinkling lights will look incredible around you!

explorer_plus.fact: Singapore has four official languages — English, Malay, Mandarin and Tamil — and the national anthem is sung in Malay.

quiz.q: teamLab's artworks change as you move near them. How is that possible?
quiz.a: Sensors and computers generate the art live in real time — it's made by code, not pre-recorded video.

activities.title: Colourful streets, marigolds and spices
activities.body: Little India is one of the most vibrant neighbourhoods in Singapore! Streets decorated with marigold garlands, the smell of spices in the air, colourful temples around every corner.
facts: Singapore has 4 official languages: English, Mandarin, Malay, and Tamil. Most signs show all 4! Can you spot signs in all 4 languages? 👀

challenge.prompt: Find all 4 in Little India: 🌼 A garland of marigold flowers  🛕 A Hindu temple  🌶️ A spice being ground or sold  📜 Tamil script (squiggly letters!)
challenge.answer: Tamil script looks like beautiful curvy squiggles — one of the world's oldest languages! The Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple on Serangoon Rd is stunning.

activities.title: Red lanterns, temples and souvenirs
activities.body: From Little India we jump on the MRT (same line!) to Chinatown — red lanterns, the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, and amazing shops. About 75% of Singapore's people are Chinese.
facts: The Buddha Tooth Relic Temple houses a tooth believed to be 1,500 years old! 🏛️

challenge.prompt: How old is the tooth inside the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple? A) 500 years  B) 1,500 years  C) 2,500 years?
challenge.answer: B! It's 1,500 years old — believed to have belonged to the historical Buddha and brought to Singapore from Myanmar.

location.name: AiFOKATO, Telok Ayer (5 min walk from Chinatown)

safe_dishes: Gelato affogato (check gelato flavours — most are nut-free)
meal.allergy_protocol: AiFOKATO lets you pick your gelato flavour before the espresso pour. For Lenny, choose fruit-based, chocolate, or vanilla flavours. Confirm with staff that the gelato and espresso used contain no nuts.

safety.note: Lenny: choose fruit/chocolate/vanilla gelato, confirm nut-free.

activities.title: Singapore's first DIY affogato bar
activities.body: Pick your gelato flavour — then watch them pour a hot shot of espresso (or matcha or chocolate) right over the top. 'Affogato' means 'drowned' in Italian. Beautiful diamond-cut cups and wildly Instagrammable. $10/cup. 💎
facts: Affogato means 'drowned' in Italian — your gelato gets 'drowned' in hot espresso. AiFOKATO is Singapore's super-premium take on the Italian classic.

days.label: Day 9
days.summary: Gardens by the Bay + TWO Light Shows!

weather.summary: Warm and partly cloudy — 31°C. Cooling off nicely at night for the light shows!

star_challenge.title: Supertree Photographer
star_challenge.prompt: Everyone takes their BEST photo at BOTH light shows tonight — Supertrees AND Spectra. Who took the most magical shot? 🌟

activities.title: Cocktail-inspired specialty coffee
activities.body: Tiny but legendary coffee stand famous for cocktail-inspired specialty drinks — espresso-blood orange blends, cold brews with wild seasonal combos. Walk 5 min to Koon Seng Road after for Singapore's most photographed heritage shophouses. Drinks ~$8–9 SGD, opens 8am.
facts: Joo Chiat is one of Singapore's most colourful neighbourhoods, packed with Peranakan heritage shophouses in vivid pinks, greens and blues. 📸

location.name: Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay

activities.title: 35-metre indoor waterfall in a mountain of mist
activities.body: The Cloud Forest is like stepping into a magical mist-covered mountain! A MASSIVE 35-metre indoor waterfall — the tallest indoor waterfall in the world — and a spiral walkway up through tropical cloud-forest plants.
facts: The Cloud Forest keeps itself cool at 23–25°C — much cooler than outside. It simulates the cool mountain environment where these plants naturally grow. 🌡️

challenge.prompt: Walk to the very TOP of the Cloud Forest without taking the lift — count every step on the spiral walkway! How many steps to the top? First one up picks dessert! 🌿
challenge.answer: It's about 35 metres high — taller than a 10-storey building! The views at the top are worth every step.

explorer_plus.fact: The Supertrees are giant vertical gardens; several collect rainwater and have solar panels that power the night show.

quiz.q: The Cloud Forest dome holds one of the world's tallest indoor waterfalls. Roughly how tall is it?
quiz.a: About 35 metres — taller than a 10-storey building.

location.name: Gardens by the Bay + Marina Bay

activities.title: Supertrees at 7:45pm — free!
activities.body: 18 giant Supertrees (25–50 metres tall) covered in plants light up, glow and pulse with music. Like standing in a glowing alien forest. Then walk 10 min to Marina Bay Sands for Spectra at 9pm — 15 min of water jets, lasers and light projected on a screen of mist.
facts: The Supertrees work like real trees — collecting rainwater, generating solar energy, and filtering air. Future technology made real! 🌱

challenge.prompt: Best photo at EACH light show — Supertrees AND Spectra. Show the photos to each other: who took the most magical shot? 🌟
challenge.answer: Turn off your flash, hold very still, and try to include people in the foreground with lights behind. Magic! ✨

weather.summary: Warm — 32°C. Perfect for air-con malls and shopping!

star_challenge.title: Souvenir Hunter
star_challenge.prompt: Find the PERFECT souvenir for ONE person back home — budget $10 SGD. Think about what they'd love! 🛍️

activities.title: Singapore's famous shopping street
activities.body: Orchard Road is basically one giant mall after another for about 2 kilometres! Great for souvenirs, gifts for back home, and anything you forgot to pack.
facts: Orchard Road is named after the fruit orchards and nutmeg plantations that used to grow here in the 1800s. Now it's all shopping malls — quite a change! 🥭

challenge.prompt: Each kid: find the PERFECT souvenir for ONE person back home (friend, teacher, grandparent). Budget: $10 SGD. GO! 🛍️
challenge.answer: Think about what that person LIKES — not just what looks cool to you. A thoughtful gift is always better than an expensive one!

explorer_plus.fact: Chilli crab was invented in Singapore in the 1950s and is now one of the country's most famous national dishes.

quiz.q: Orchard Road is named after what used to grow there in the 1800s?
quiz.a: Orchards, plus nutmeg and pepper plantations.

moments.title: The Line Buffet — Eat the World!

location.name: The Line, Shangri-La Hotel, Orchard Road

avoid_dishes: Desserts with nut toppings (check the sundae bar)
Any Indian curry with peanut-based sauce
meal.allergy_protocol: Large buffet — HIGH cross-contamination risk. On arrival, speak to the head chef/manager: identify which stations are safe for Lenny. Asian hawker-style stations (satay, Indian curry) carry highest risk. French and Italian stations are generally safer. Use serving utensils only from safe stations — don't reach across nut-containing dishes. EpiPen in bag at the table.

safety.note: Lenny: high cross-contamination risk. Pre-arrange with head chef on arrival. EpiPen at table.

activities.title: 300 dishes, all you can eat!
activities.body: The Line at Shangri-La is Singapore's most famous buffet — over 300 dishes from all around the world, all you can eat. Japanese, Italian, Indian, Chinese, French, desserts — you name it.
facts: If you tried one dish from every country at the buffet, you'd eat food from over 15 nations in one sitting! 🏆

challenge.prompt: How many different COUNTRIES can you eat food from in one dinner? Sushi, pasta, curry, French pastry… count them! Most countries on your plate WINS! 🗺️
challenge.answer: Don't forget to save room for dessert — the chocolate fountain and ice cream station are legendary. Strategic buffet planning is key! 🍫

days.label: Day 11
days.did_you_know: The Battlestar Galactica roller coasters were closed for maintenance but REOPEN on exactly 6 July — our day! We planned this perfectly! 🎢

weather.summary: Sunny and hot — 33°C. Bring hats for queues. Park has air-con throughout!

star_challenge.title: Character Collector
star_challenge.prompt: Get a photo with a character from EACH of the 7 zones at Universal Studios! Minions, Transformers, Puss in Boots, Shrek, a dino, a mummy, and a Nintendo character!

activities.title: Flying over the harbour to Universal's front door
activities.body: We ride the cable car ONE WAY into Sentosa — instead of a boring bus, we fly over the water with incredible views of Singapore's harbour, ships, and the city skyline all the way to Universal's entrance. So much better than the MRT! 🏙️
facts: The Singapore Cable Car has been running since 1974! It's one of the only cable cars in the world that passes through an office building AND over a busy highway. 🏢

challenge.prompt: From the cable car, count: ⚓ Ships in the harbour  🏗️ Construction cranes  🌴 Palm trees on Sentosa  🏙️ How many skyscrapers?
challenge.answer: Singapore is one of the world's busiest ports — you might spot over 100 ships waiting! The port handles 1 in 5 of the world's shipping containers.

explorer_plus.fact: Universal Studios Singapore is the smallest Universal park in the world, but it packs seven themed zones inside.

quiz.q: Battlestar Galactica is a 'duelling' coaster. What makes it special?
quiz.a: Two trains launch and race side-by-side on separate tracks, passing within metres of each other.

location.name: Universal Studios Singapore, Resorts World Sentosa

activities.title: 7 themed zones, ALL coasters open today
activities.body: Universal Studios Singapore has 7 amazing zones: Battlestar Galactica (world's tallest duelling coasters! — two tracks racing side by side), Transformers 3D, Jurassic World river rapids, Revenge of the Mummy indoor coaster, Minion Land (brand new 2026 with 3 rides!), Super Nintendo World (brand new 2026!), and DreamWorks.
facts: Battlestar Galactica REOPENS TODAY — two trains launch and race side-by-side on separate tracks, passing within metres of each other. The world's tallest duelling coasters! 🎢

challenge.prompt: Collect a photo with a character from EACH of the 7 zones! Minions, Transformers, Puss in Boots, Shrek, a dino, a mummy, and a Nintendo character! 📸
challenge.answer: Characters rotate around the park — ask a staff member for the character meet-and-greet schedule at the entrance!

weather.summary: Warm and tropical — 31°C. Last Singapore sunset!

hotel.name: Treetops Singapore, Bukit Timah
hotel.note: Flight departs 9PM — check out morning, store bags, head to Jewel!

star_challenge.title: Rain Vortex Timer
star_challenge.prompt: Stand at the edge of the Rain Vortex waterfall and count: how many seconds does it take one drop to fall from TOP to BOTTOM? 💧

activities.title: The world's best airport has an indoor waterfall
activities.body: Changi Airport is voted the WORLD'S BEST AIRPORT nearly every year — and Jewel is why! A giant glass dome with the Rain Vortex: the world's tallest indoor waterfall (40 metres — as tall as a 13-storey building!). Plus slides, a butterfly garden, and rooftop forest.
facts: The Rain Vortex uses rainwater collected from the glass roof — at night, coloured lights shine through the falling water. 💡

challenge.prompt: Stand at the very edge of the Rain Vortex and count: how many seconds does it take for one drop of water to fall from the TOP to the BOTTOM? 💧
challenge.answer: It's 40 metres tall — water takes about 2–3 seconds to fall. That's the same height as a 13-storey building!

explorer_plus.fact: Jewel's Rain Vortex is the world's tallest indoor waterfall (about 40 m) and recycles collected rainwater.

quiz.q: Changi is often voted the world's best airport. Name one surprising thing inside it.
quiz.a: It has an indoor waterfall, a butterfly garden, slides, and rooftop gardens — inside the terminals!

activities.title: QF82 → Sydney → Adelaide
activities.body: Our flight QF82 leaves at 9PM and flies to Sydney overnight. Then QF733 from Sydney back to Adelaide, arriving 11:05am on 8 July. What a trip it's been! 🇸🇬

challenge.prompt: Everyone answer: What was your #1 favourite moment of the WHOLE trip? And what food would you eat again RIGHT NOW if you could? 🌏
challenge.answer: These memories are yours forever. Singapore will always be part of your story! 🇸🇬❤️
